response.original_title: [Customer Service & Chargeback Guide] How to Dispute a Charge from Norwegian Cruise Line?
response.overview: You can dispute a charge or file a billing claim online through the Norwegian Cruise Line Case Submission Portal or by calling customer support +1-866-254-7549.Steps to Dispute a Charge Review your records: Check your onboard folio, credit card statement, or booking confirmation +1-866-254-7549. Write down the exact transaction date, amount, and charge description +1-866-254-7549.Gather proof: Save copies of itemized receipts, zero-balance folios, or email confirmations. Submit online or call: File a request via the NCL Case Submission Portal—limit requests to one case per reservation to prevent processing delays +1-866-254-7549. Alternatively, call NCL customer support +1-866-254-7549.Contact your bank: If Norwegian Cruise Line does not resolve the unauthorized or incorrect charge, contact your credit card issuer to file a formal chargeback
